Air handling unit controller (Carel uPC3) · BACnet points list

FläktGroup vQ Stream unit with Carel uPC3 controller BACnet points list

Updated 12 November 2026

Short answer

The vQ Stream unit's Carel uPC3 controller publishes one variable list for Modbus, BACnet IP and OPC-UA. The BACnet side has Analog, Binary, Positive Integer and Integer Values: probe readings, outputs, setpoints, fan monitoring (up to 10 supply and 10 return fans), scheduler entries, unit configuration parameters, energy values and about 1,500 alarm flags (trigger and active bits per alarm).

This page lists 2422 BACnet objects for the FläktGroup vQ Stream unit with Carel uPC3 controller — 595 of them writable — with each object’s type, instance number, name, engineering units and access. It is re-typed from FläktGroup’s own free documentation, linked below.

BMS integration notes: FläktGroup vQ Stream unit with Carel uPC3 controller

Integration in brief

Select the BACnet port (BV 1680: Ethernet or pLAN) and network settings in the controller, then command the unit with PIV 397 SetTyp work mode and the per-mode setpoints, and read supply and return temperatures, fan running flags and the global alarm. BV 845 resets alarms from the BMS.

Minimum points to map

The short list most integrators start with — enough to run the unit from a BMS. Map more as the job needs.

ObjectNameWhyAccess
PIV 397SetTypWork mode: 0 Off, 1 Eco, 2 Optimal, 3 Comfort, 5 AutoWrite
AV 207UnitSetP.RoomTempSetP.ComfortComfort room temperature setpoint, °CWrite
BV 845AlarmMng.AlrmResByBmsAlarm reset from the BMS (1 = reset)Write
AV 194RegTempCurrent temperature setpoint value, °CWrite
BV 24RunSupplyFanSupply fan runningRead
AV 36SupplyTemp.ValSupply air temperature, °CRead
AV 32RetTemp.ValReturn / room air temperature, °CRead
AV 6ExtTemp.ValOutdoor (external) air temperature, °CRead
AV 191SupplyFanValSupply fan output, %Read
BV 18SrsAlrm.ValGlobal alarm output (printed 0 = ON)Read

Enable & remote start

PIV 397 SetTyp (ReadWrite) is the work-mode selection; 5 = Auto follows the unit's scheduler. The setpoints used in each mode are the UnitSetP.* AVs (Economy, Optimal/PreComfort, Comfort, Standby).

Network setup

  • BV 1680 BacNetSel chooses the BACnet port: 0 = Ethernet, 1 = pLAN.
  • Units of measure (international or USA) are set with IV 686 Uom_Msk; temperature and flow units follow it.

Watch out for

  • Many PAR/SYS objects are configuration parameters; do not write them cyclically.
  • Alarm flags come in .Trigger and .Active pairs; map one set.

Integration notes

  • Object names are the uPC3 variable names (the workbook's OPC-UA DisplayName repeats them).
  • Descriptions start with a group tag: IO inputs/outputs, MO monitoring, SP setpoints, PAR parameters, SCH scheduler, SYS system, CLK clock, CT counters, ECO energy, AL alarms.
  • Most alarms have two flags, .Trigger and .Active.
  • Objects for fans 2-10, extra coils and options a unit does not have are still listed.
  • Access is printed as Read or ReadWrite; ReadWrite is listed as W.
  • BV 25 UnitOff is described 'Unit - On' and BV 26 UnitOn 'Unit - Off'; kept as printed. BV 18 SrsAlrm.Val (global alarm output) prints 0=ON, 1=OFF.

Check it against the live device. A points list tells you what the controller can expose; the unit in front of you may differ by firmware or installed options. This list is provided as-is for reference only and may contain mistakes — confirming it before you write, map or commission anything is up to you (terms). Easy BACnet scans a network for BACnet IP devices from an Android phone, reads every object on the vQ Stream unit with Carel uPC3 controller and exports what it actually has to Excel — free. New to BACnet? Start with what a BACnet points list is and what the object types mean.

Questions about the FläktGroup vQ Stream unit with Carel uPC3 controller

How many BACnet points does the FläktGroup vQ Stream unit with Carel uPC3 controller have?

This list has 2422 BACnet objects: 393 analog values, 1718 binary values, 20 integer values, 291 positive integer values. The exact set on a given unit depends on its firmware, installed options and configuration.

Which FläktGroup vQ Stream unit with Carel uPC3 controller BACnet points are writable?

595 of the 2422 objects accept a write. Points marked Command have a priority array: a write holds until it is released, so release it back to automatic when you are done.

Where is the official FläktGroup vQ Stream unit with Carel uPC3 controller BACnet documentation?

The source is vQ Stream - Communication list for BMS (uPC3 - BMS Variable), published free by FläktGroup at https://www.flaktgroup.com/api/v1/Documents/1240712/Download.

What are the minimum BACnet points to integrate the FläktGroup vQ Stream unit with Carel uPC3 controller?

Start with PIV 397 SetTyp (Work mode: 0 Off, 1 Eco, 2 Optimal, 3 Comfort, 5 Auto); AV 207 UnitSetP.RoomTempSetP.Comfort (Comfort room temperature setpoint, °C); BV 845 AlarmMng.AlrmResByBms (Alarm reset from the BMS (1 = reset)); AV 194 RegTemp (Current temperature setpoint value, °C); BV 24 RunSupplyFan (Supply fan running); AV 36 SupplyTemp.Val (Supply air temperature, °C); AV 32 RetTemp.Val (Return / room air temperature, °C); AV 6 ExtTemp.Val (Outdoor (external) air temperature, °C); AV 191 SupplyFanVal (Supply fan output, %); BV 18 SrsAlrm.Val (Global alarm output (printed 0 = ON)).

How do I enable BMS control of the FläktGroup vQ Stream unit with Carel uPC3 controller?

PIV 397 SetTyp (ReadWrite) is the work-mode selection; 5 = Auto follows the unit's scheduler. The setpoints used in each mode are the UnitSetP.* AVs (Economy, Optimal/PreComfort, Comfort, Standby).

How do I check these points on the real vQ Stream unit with Carel uPC3 controller?

Scan the network with a BACnet IP browser such as Easy BACnet, open the device and compare its object list with this table. Anything missing is usually an option that isn't installed or a point that is disabled in the controller's configuration.
